name: Ellaria: Cotton & Cream
source:
Dive in to the mystical land of Ellaria, where Elves, Fairies, and Demons rule supreme, and other races are no more than an afterthought on the authors fingertips. Enjoy a tale of action, adventure, romance, and a whole lot of snark. Bring your armor folks, lest you get injured by all the fourth wall breaking.

[From [url=https://fablesoft.itch.io/ellaria-cotton-cream]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
潜入埃拉里亚的神秘土地，在那里精灵、仙女和恶魔统治着至高无上的世界，而其他种族只不过是作者指尖上的事后想法。享受一个充满动作、冒险、浪漫和大量恶作剧的故事。带上你的盔甲人员，以免第四堵墙被破坏时受伤。

[来自[url=https://fablesoft.itch.io/ellaria-cotton-cream]itch.io[/url]]
